title: DIODE LASER PHOTOCOAGUALTION AS A NOVEL METHOD FOR SOCKET SEALING DURING ALVEOLAR SOCKET PRESERVATION
authors: Kamal, A. A., Khadr, A., Abd El Aziz, M., & Taalab, M. R. Alexandria Dental Journal. 2021 Aug; 46(2), 54- 62. Doi: 10.21608/ADJALEXU.2020.28747.1066.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The laser photocoagulation is as effective as the dPTFE membrane in sealing sockets after grafting” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
